weekLabel: Sun Nov 15 cook · Mon Nov 16 – Sun Nov 22
notes: 3 people (Rory, Wendy, Chloe). Tue Nov 17 = car-jar dinner after dance + Wendy's bowl at home; Sat Nov 21 = night out. Mild for Chloe and Wendy, heat on the side for Rory. Quality: organic; beef grass-fed/finished; chicken organic AND air-chilled only (Whole Foods); seafood wild-caught; eggs OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free; yogurt Maple Hill grass-fed Greek (Publix). Rice in bone broth; gelatin in beef. Low oil. Named low-cal sides. Macros are estimates.

costEstimates.label: Estimated · excl. tax/delivery

dinners.name: Honey-garlic glazed wild salmon + lemon broccoli
dinners.desc: Wild sockeye with a quick tamari-honey-garlic glaze (no oil), roasted at 425°F, over Sunday's bone broth rice with lemon broth-steamed broccoli. Mild; chili crisp on the side for Rory.

ingredients: 1.25 lb (567 g) wild-caught sockeye, cut in 3 portions (frozen on delivery; fridge Sunday morning)
Glaze: 20 g low-sodium tamari, 15 g honey, 1 garlic clove grated, 3 g fresh ginger grated, 5 g lime juice, 20 g bone broth
Lemon broccoli (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 50): 1 lb broccoli crowns in florets (~400 g trimmed), 80 g bone broth, ¼ tsp salt, zest of ½ lemon + 1 tsp juice
330 g bone broth rice (fridge, Sunday): Rory 120 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 100, + 2 Tbsp broth
Sesame seeds + sliced green onion to finish; Rory only: chili crisp
steps: 5:00: oven to 425°F, rack upper-middle; parchment-lined half-sheet pan, sprayed.
Simmer the glaze in a small saucepan 2–3 min until it coats a spoon (~40 g). Set aside half for the table.
Pat the salmon dry, skin-side down on the pan, pinch of salt, brush with half the glaze.
5:08: roast 10–12 min until the thickest part is 145°F and flakes. Pull Chloe's smaller piece 2 min early once it hits 145°F.
5:10: broccoli + broth in a 12-in lidded skillet, covered, high heat 4–5 min until bright green and crisp-tender; uncover 1 min to cook off the liquid; salt, zest, lemon.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min to steaming.
Spoon the reserved glaze over the fish; sesame + green onion.
Rory: 190 g cooked salmon, 120 g rice, 150 g broccoli ≈ 569 cal / 58 g P.

dinners.name: Car dinner after dance (Rory + Chloe): shredded beef rice jars · Wendy's bowl at home
dinners.desc: Sunday's citrus-garlic beef over cilantro-lime rice, packed hot in thermal jars to eat in the car after dance, with crema in steel cups and cucumber/pepper spears on the side. Wendy has the same bowl at home with a fried egg on top. 15 minutes before you leave.
dinners.side: Cucumber + red bell pepper spears (+ apple slices for Chloe)

recipe.serves: 3: Rory + Chloe in the car, Wendy at home (beef: Rory 150 g · Chloe 70 · Wendy 140)
recipe.time: 15 min before you leave for dance
ingredients: 360 g shredded beef + ½ cup juices (fridge, Sunday)
370 g bone broth rice (fridge, Sunday): Rory 150 · Chloe 100 · Wendy 120, + 8 g chopped cilantro + 8 g lime juice + 2 Tbsp broth
Lime crema (Sunday batch): Rory 30 g · Wendy 30 g · Chloe 15 g in lidded steel dip cups
Spears: 1 English cucumber + 1 red bell pepper in sticks (~300 g; Rory 150 g, Chloe 60 g, Wendy 80 g); 1 small apple sliced for Chloe
Wendy: 1 OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free egg, fried with spray

Gear: Chloe's 12 oz LunchBots thermal jar + a second wide-mouth thermal jar for Rory (or a glass container in the insulated bag, eaten within 2 hours), insulated bag, ice pack for the crema + spears, forks, napkins; Rory's chipotle/hot sauce
steps: Preheat both jars with boiling water 5–10 min; dump.
Heat the beef with its juices in a covered stainless skillet over medium 4–5 min, stirring, to 165°F (steaming).
Microwave the rice covered with 2 Tbsp broth 2–3 min to steaming; stir in the cilantro and lime.
Jars: rice first, beef on top, lids on tight. Spears, apple and crema cups in the bento with an ice pack. Eat within 4 hours (jars hold above 140°F about 4–5 hours).
Wendy (at home): reheat her beef + rice to 165°F, fry the egg 2–3 min with a lid for 30 s, top with crema; spears on the side.
Rory: 150 g beef, 150 g rice, 30 g crema, 150 g spears ≈ 575 cal / 52 g P.

dinners.name: Steak night: seared grass-fed sirloin + chimichurri
dinners.desc: Rotation winner ('absolute banger'): hard-seared grass-fed top sirloin, low-oil chimichurri (red pepper flakes only in Rory's), oven-roasted Yukon potatoes at 425°F on two pans (oven, not air fryer). This week's green is lemon-garlic roasted asparagus, since Friday's Peruvian chicken gets the green beans.
dinners.side: Oven-roasted Yukon potatoes + lemon-garlic roasted asparagus

ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) grass-fed top sirloin, ~1 in thick (frozen on delivery; fridge Mon night)
1 tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, avocado-oil spray

Chimichurri (~100 g): 30 g flat-leaf parsley chopped fine, 2 garlic cloves minced, ¾ tsp dried oregano, 20 g red wine vinegar, 10 g lemon juice, 18 g (4 tsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 20 g water, ⅓ tsp kosher salt, pinch of pepper. Rory's portion: + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes. Make Tue night or Wed; rest 15 min+.
Potatoes: 650 g Yukon Golds in 1-in chunks, split across 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans, spray, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika (Rory 180 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 80 cooked)

Lemon-garlic asparagus (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40): 1.5 lb asparagus (2 bunches), woody ends snapped (~450 g trimmed), spray, ½ tsp salt, 1 garlic clove grated, zest of ½ lemon + squeeze
steps: 4:45: salt the steaks; counter 30–40 min. Oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle.
5:00: potatoes in (both pans), 30–35 min, shaking at 15 and 25 min and swapping racks once, until deep golden.
5:18: push the potatoes to one side of each pan (or use a third small pan); asparagus in with spray and salt, 10–12 min until tender-crisp. Garlic, zest and lemon after.

5:20: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high 3 min, spray, sear the steaks 4–5 min per side to 130–135°F for medium-rare (USDA: 145°F; Chloe's piece to 145°F if she prefers). Rest 5–10 min, slice against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced steak (Rory's from his spicy portion).
Rory: 170 g cooked sirloin, 180 g potatoes, 150 g asparagus, 25 g chimichurri ≈ 564 cal / 59 g P.
Tonight: blend the Wed-night aji verde; move Rory's Thu box, Wendy's Thu box, Thu dinner rice and Chloe's Thu jar to the fridge; pack Chloe's crema cup.

dinners.name: Greek beef-herb meatballs + tzatziki + rice
dinners.desc: Tender grass-fed beef meatballs with parsley, dill, garlic, parmesan and gelatin (no frying; baked on a sheet pan), with Maple Hill tzatziki, bone broth rice and a crunchy Greek cucumber-tomato salad. Mild; Aleppo or red pepper flakes on the side for Rory. Makes Wendy's Friday lunch and refills Chloe's mini-meatball stash in the freezer.
dinners.side: Greek cucumber-tomato salad (lemon, oregano, no oil)

recipe.serves: 3 + Wendy's Fri lunch + ~12 mini meatballs for Chloe's freezer (cooked: Rory 180 g · Wendy 150 · Chloe 80 · Wendy Fri 150)
ingredients: 2 lb (907 g) organic grass-fed 93% lean ground beef (frozen on delivery; fridge Tue night)
1 OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free egg, 35 g organic quick oats (or rolled, pulsed), 25 g grated parmesan
5 g (1 tsp) gelatin bloomed in 30 g bone broth (Rory's gelatin rule; keeps lean beef juicy)
15 g parsley + 5 g dill, chopped fine; 3 garlic cloves grated; 60 g grated yellow onion, squeezed
3 g (1 tsp) dried oregano, 2 g (1 tsp) cumin, 1¼ tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray

Tzatziki (~155 g; Rory 40 · Wendy 40 · Chloe 20 · Wendy Fri 30): 100 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, 60 g grated English cucumber squeezed dry (~40 g), 5 g chopped dill, 8 g lemon juice, ½ garlic clove grated, 1.5 g salt

Greek salad (~330 g; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40 + Wendy Fri 40): ½ English cucumber diced, 200 g cherry tomatoes halved, 20 g red onion sliced thin, 10 g lemon juice, ½ tsp dried oregano, ¼ tsp salt. No oil.
450 g bone broth rice (frozen Sunday; fridge Wed night): Rory 110 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 100 · Wendy Fri 120, + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory only: Aleppo or red pepper flakes
steps: 4:50: oven to 425°F, rack in the middle; parchment-lined half-sheet pan, sprayed.
Mix the bloomed gelatin, egg, oats, parmesan, herbs, garlic, onion and spices; add the beef and mix gently with your hands just until combined (don't overwork).
Roll 1¼-in meatballs (~30 g raw, about 28) for dinner, then 12 mini ones (~15 g) from the last ~180 g for Chloe. Space on the pan; spray the tops.
5:00: bake 14–16 min (minis 10–12; pull them first) until browned and 160°F inside.
While they bake: make the tzatziki and the salad (salt the salad at the table so it stays crisp).
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 3 min to steaming.
Pack first: Wendy's Fri lunch 150 g meatballs + 120 g rice + 40 g salad + 30 g tzatziki (fridge, eat Fri). Cool the 12 minis on a plate, then freeze on a tray and bag (Chloe's future lunches).
Rory: 180 g meatballs, 110 g rice, 40 g tzatziki, 150 g salad ≈ 572 cal / 55 g P.
Tonight: Rory's Fri box → fridge; 2.5 lb thighs into the Peruvian marinade (or Fri morning).

dinners.name: Peruvian garlic-cumin chicken thighs + aji verde
dinners.desc: Rotation winner ('incredible'), cooked the way Rory loved it: thighs packed snug on ONE pan so the juice pools, then the pan juices reduced into a glaze; Yukon potatoes split across TWO pans; lemon-garlic green beans; aji verde with jalapeño in Rory's only. Scaled to 2.5 lb for 3 with Saturday lunch leftovers.
dinners.side: Smoky oven potatoes (2 pans) + lemon-garlic green beans

recipe.serves: 3 + ~350 g cooked chicken for Rory + Wendy's Saturday lunch (cooked: Rory 180 g · Wendy 150 · Chloe 70)
recipe.time: Marinate ≥2 hr (Thu night or Fri AM) · ~40 min at 425°F
ingredients: 2.5 lb (1.13 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken thighs (frozen on delivery; fridge Wed night)

Marinade (no oil): 16 g garlic (5 cloves) grated, 30 g lime juice (2 limes) + zest of 1, 20 g coconut aminos, 5 g (2 tsp) smoked paprika, 4 g (1¼ tsp) ground cumin, 1.5 g (¾ tsp) dried oregano, 6 g (1 tsp) kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, 7 g honey
Aji verde: use the Wed-night batch (Rory 40 g with jalapeño, Wendy 30 g, none for Chloe)

Potatoes: 600 g Yukon Golds in 1-in chunks, split across TWO parchment-lined half-sheet pans (300 g each), spray, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ¼ tsp cumin (Rory 150 · Wendy 130 · Chloe 80 cooked)
Lemon-garlic green beans (~260 g cooked; Rory 120 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40): 300 g green beans trimmed, 100 g bone broth, 2 garlic cloves sliced, zest of ½ lemon + 1 tsp juice, ¼ tsp salt
steps: 4:30 PM: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle. Chicken: ONE parchment-lined, sprayed quarter-sheet pan or 9×13 (2.5 lb fills it snugly, which is what makes the juice pool); scrape the marinade on top.
4:40: chicken in on the upper-middle rack; both potato pans below (or side by side). Shake the potatoes at 15 and 25 min.
Bake the chicken 30–35 min to 175°F. Potatoes 30–35 min until browned and crisp.
5:05: green beans in a wide lidded pan with the broth and garlic: covered 6–7 min, then uncover and cook off the liquid 1–2 min; zest, juice, salt.
5:15: chicken to a board. Pour the pooled pan juices into a small skillet and boil 3–4 min until syrupy; toss it over the chicken (the glaze Rory loved).
Pack ~350 g leftover chicken (fridge) for Saturday lunch.
Rory: 180 g chicken, 150 g potatoes, 120 g green beans, 40 g aji verde ≈ 566 cal / 54 g P.

dinners.name: Night out
dinners.desc: Saturday is our standing night out. No prep, nothing bought for it. Lunch = Friday's leftover Peruvian chicken. Sun Nov 22's cook (Thanksgiving week) gets planned next Thursday.

dinners.name: Mild citrus-garlic shredded chuck (barbacoa-style) + cilantro-lime rice
dinners.desc: Grass-fed chuck braised low and slow with orange, lime, garlic, cumin and oregano, plus Rory's no-sear method: tomato paste + miso and gelatin bloomed in the broth. Totally mild; chipotle in adobo on the side for Rory. Served over cilantro-lime bone broth rice with lime crema and lime-garlic roasted zucchini. Makes Tuesday's car jars, Wendy's Tue bowl and Chloe's Thursday lunch.

recipe.serves: 3 tonight (cooked beef: Rory 170 g · Wendy 140 · Chloe 70) + 360 g for Tue jars/bowl + 70 g for Chloe's Thu lunch
recipe.time: 20 min prep · 4 hr covered at 325°F · in the oven by 12:45 PM · dinner ~5:15
ingredients: 3.5 lb (1.59 kg) grass-fed chuck roast, cut into 4 big chunks (fridge, from delivery)
1 medium yellow onion, sliced (~150 g)
6 garlic cloves, smashed
120 g fresh orange juice (2 navel oranges) + 45 g lime juice (3 limes)
15 g (1 Tbsp) apple cider vinegar
6 g (2 tsp) ground cumin, 3 g (1½ tsp) dried oregano, 3 g (1 tsp) smoked paprika, 2 bay leaves
16 g (1 Tbsp) tomato paste + 6 g (1 tsp) white miso whisked into a little of the broth
420 g (1¾ cups) organic bone broth, the only other liquid. Bloom 10 g (1½ Tbsp) gelatin in 60 g of this measured broth.
10 g (2 tsp) honey (balances the citrus; not sweet)
1½ tsp kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper. No oil, no sear.
Rory only: 1 chipotle in adobo, minced into his portion of juices (or hot sauce)
Cilantro-lime rice: 340 g bone broth rice (today's batch) + 10 g chopped cilantro + 10 g lime juice + pinch of salt: Rory 120 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 100
Lime crema (Sunday batch ~190 g, fridge; serves Sun + Tue + Chloe Thu): 170 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt + zest of 1 lime + 20 g lime juice + 1.5 g salt. Tonight: Rory 30 · Wendy 30 · Chloe 15
steps: 12:15 PM: oven to 325°F, rack in the lower third for the covered 5–6 qt Dutch oven or ceramic pot.
Pat the chuck dry; season all sides with the salt, pepper, cumin, oregano and paprika. No sear: straight into the pot on top of the onion and garlic.
Whisk the orange and lime juice, vinegar, honey, tomato paste-miso and the broth with the bloomed gelatin; pour around the beef. Tuck in the bay leaves.
By 12:45: lid on tight, braise 4 hours undisturbed.
4:45: done when it shreds easily with two forks (~200–205°F inside). If it resists, 20–30 min more.
4:50: fish out the bay leaves. Shred in the pot and toss through the juices. If thin, simmer uncovered on the stove 5–8 min until it coats the beef.
Before plating, pack: Tue container 360 g beef + ½ cup juices (FRIDGE, for Tue) and Chloe's Thu container 70 g beef + 1 Tbsp juices + 100 g rice (FREEZER).
Stir the cilantro, lime and salt into tonight's warm rice.
Rory: 170 g beef with juices (+ chipotle), 120 g cilantro-lime rice, 30 g crema, 150 g zucchini ≈ 580 cal / 56 g P.
recipe.scale: Rory's roast method (no sear, miso + tomato paste, gelatin in the broth) at 1× liquids for a 3–4 lb roast.
recipe.leftovers: 360 g beef → Tue car jars + Wendy's bowl (fridge). 70 g → Chloe's Thu lunch (freezer). Anything extra → Rory's breakfast eggs.

sideRecipes.title: Lime-garlic roasted zucchini (start 4:40)
ingredients: 3 medium organic zucchini (~600 g), halved lengthwise, then 1-in half-moons
Avocado-oil spray, ½ tsp kosher salt, 1 garlic clove grated
Zest of ½ lime + 10 g lime juice, 3 g chopped cilantro
steps: When the roast comes out at 4:45, raise the oven to 425°F (rack upper-middle). Line a half-sheet pan with parchment.
Zucchini cut-side down in one layer, spray, salt. Roast 16–18 min until browned on the cut side and just tender (not mushy).
Toss hot with the garlic, lime zest and juice and cilantro.

sideRecipes.title: Lemon-oregano chicken breasts (Sunday: 9 'fire' lunches + Chloe's Mon lunch)
sideRecipes.serves: 5.5 lb raw → ~1,850 g cooked (weigh actual yield): Rory 5 × 200 g · Wendy 4 × 150 g · Chloe Mon 70 g · ~180 g spare
sideRecipes.time: 15 min + ~80 min air fryer (4 batches, mostly hands-off)
ingredients: 5.5 lb (2.5 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken breasts, thick ends pounded to ¾ in
Zest of 2 lemons + 60 g lemon juice
4 g (2 tsp) dried oregano, 8 g (1 Tbsp) garlic powder, 4 g (2 tsp) smoked paprika
16 g (2¾ tsp) kosher salt, 1 tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon, spices and salt in a big bowl; spray lightly.
Air-fry about 1⅜ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min (single layer, don't stack), flipping halfway, to 165°F in the thickest part. Batches at ~12:55, 1:15, 1:35, 1:55.
Rest 5 min on a board, slice, and weigh into containers in the 2:25 step.

sideRecipes.title: 'Fire' lunch boxes: Rory ×5 (Mon–Fri) + Wendy ×4 (Mon–Thu), peas and carrots, aji verde
sideRecipes.serves: 9 lunches + Chloe's Tue fried rice veg
ingredients: Chicken from above: Rory 5 × 200 g, Wendy 4 × 150 g
Bone broth rice (today's batch): 9 × 120 g = 1,080 g

Peas and carrots (need ~1,190 g cooked): 3 × 16 oz bags organic frozen peas and carrots, 90 g bone broth, ¾ tsp salt, 1½ tsp honey, juice of ½ lemon. Rory 150 g per box, Wendy 100 g per box, + 40 g for Chloe's Tue fried rice.
Aji verde, Sunday batch (~250 g, for Mon–Wed boxes): 180 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, 30 g cilantro (stems ok), 15 g grated parmesan, 15 g lime juice, 1 garlic clove, 3 g salt. Blend smooth.

Aji verde, Wed-night batch (~200 g, for Thu–Fri boxes + Fri Peruvian dinner): 140 g Maple Hill, 25 g cilantro, 12 g parmesan, 12 g lime juice, 1 small garlic clove, 2.5 g salt. Rory's heat: blend ½ jalapeño or hot sauce into his cups only.
steps: Peas and carrots in 2 batches: 12-in pan, covered, with 45 g broth each, medium heat 6–7 min until hot; season with salt, honey and lemon. Spread on a plate to cool 10 min.
Blend the Sunday aji verde 30 s. Portion 6 lidded steel cups × 40 g (Rory + Wendy Mon–Wed). Fridge.
Rory's boxes (×5): 200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas and carrots. Wendy's boxes (×4): 150 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots.
FRIDGE: Rory Mon/Tue/Wed + Wendy Mon/Tue/Wed. FREEZER: Rory Thu + Fri, Wendy Thu (move to the fridge the night before).
Reheat: lid cracked, microwave 2½–3 min from the fridge to 165°F, stirring once; add the aji verde cold after.
Rory's box ≈ 623 cal · 77 g P · 52 g C · 10 g F with 40 g aji verde. Wendy's ≈ 497 cal · 61 g P.

sideRecipes.title: Chloe's Thursday jar: mild shredded beef + rice (Sunday, frozen)
ingredients: 70 g shredded citrus-garlic chuck + 1 Tbsp juices (no chipotle)
100 g bone broth rice (today's batch)
15 g lime crema in a steel dip cup (packed fresh Wed night, not frozen)
steps: 4:50: container: rice on one side, beef + juices on the other. FREEZER (Thu is frozen-on-Sunday). Move to the fridge Wed night.
Thu morning: heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 5–6 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar; crema cup cold in the bento.

chloeLunches.items: Mild lemon chicken + rice: 70 g lemon-oregano chicken over 100 g bone broth rice (container packed Sunday, fridge); 1 small apple sliced + 1 kiwi
chloeLunches.how: Heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 4–5 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar. Fruit in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Mild veggie egg fried rice: 100 g bone broth rice + 2 OrgaNICK eggs + 40 g peas and carrots (rice and veg from Sunday), 1 tsp coconut aminos, ½ tsp toasted sesame oil; 1 mandarin + 4 strawberries
chloeLunches.how: Spray a 10-in pan, scramble the eggs soft and set aside; add the rice, peas and carrots and 1 Tbsp broth, 3–4 min until steaming; fold in the eggs, aminos and sesame oil (165°F). Pack hot.

chloeLunches.items: 4–5 Bell & Evans organic nuggets + ~100 g potato wedges, 2 Tbsp honey mustard (1 Tbsp honey + 1 Tbsp Dijon) in a steel dip cup, ½ mango in chunks
chloeLunches.how: Cut 1 Yukon potato (~180 g) into 8 wedges, spray, pinch of salt; air-fry 400°F 8 min. Add the nuggets from frozen, 10–12 min more at 400°F, shaking at 6 min, to 170°F (they're sold uncooked). Pack hot in the preheated jar; mango + dip in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Mild shredded beef + rice: 70 g Sunday citrus-garlic beef + 100 g bone broth rice (frozen Sunday, fridge Wed night), 15 g lime crema in a dip cup; 1 kiwi + a handful of blueberries
chloeLunches.how: Heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 5–6 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar. Crema and fruit in the bento with an ice pack.

breakfasts: Yogurt bowls: Maple Hill grass-fed Greek yogurt + berries or kiwi, honey optional, no granola (Maple Hill: 160 cal / 15 g P per 170 g).
Eggs: 2 dozen OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free (fried or scrambled with spray); 1 for Wendy's Tue bowl, 2 for Chloe's Tue fried rice, 1 in Thursday's meatballs.

Rory's daily snacks (unchanged): Jacob bar pre-workout; 3 PM = 136 g Maple Hill + 35 g Equip chocolate peanut butter + 182 g apple. Dessert (a third of a Creami pint) right after dinner, then nothing until bed.
lunches: Grown-up lunches: Rory's 'fire' box Mon–Fri (200 g lemon-oregano chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + 150 g peas and carrots + 40 g aji verde, ≈ 623 cal / 77 g P; Thu/Fri boxes frozen Sunday). Wendy's box Mon–Thu (150 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots + 40 g aji verde; Thu frozen). Wendy's Fri lunch = Thursday's meatballs, packed Thu night. Sat lunch = Friday's leftover Peruvian chicken.

creami.name: Honey vanilla ×2
creami.desc: (per pint) 170 g Maple Hill Greek, 100 g organic low-fat cottage cheese, 40 g Grassmilk whole milk, 80 g water, 12 g honey, 2 g vanilla, 24 g Noble vanilla isolate. ≈ 402 cal · 47 g P per pint; ⅓ ≈ 134 cal · 16 g P.

creami.name: Chocolate PB ×1 (Rory's 'fire' pint, Equip)
creami.desc: 160 g Maple Hill, 110 g cottage cheese, 30 g milk, 100 g water, 8 g cocoa, 6 g honey, 1 g vanilla, 29 g Equip chocolate peanut butter. ≈ 408 cal · 51 g P; ⅓ ≈ 136 cal · 17 g P.

creami.name: Cookies & cream ×1 (Equip)
creami.desc: 160 g Maple Hill, 100 g cottage cheese, 30 g milk, 110 g water, 6 g honey, 2 g vanilla, 30 g Equip cookies & cream, 6 g cacao nibs folded in after the spin (or use Mix-in). ≈ 425 cal · 52 g P; ⅓ ≈ 142 cal · 17 g P.

creami.name: Pistachio ×1 (Wendy)
creami.desc: 160 g Maple Hill, 100 g cottage cheese, 40 g milk, 80 g water, 25 g pistachio butter (on hand), 8 g honey, 1 g vanilla, 24 g Noble. ≈ 528 cal · 51 g P; ⅓ ≈ 176 cal · 17 g P.

creami.name: Mango ×1 (pure mango)
creami.desc: 230 g ripe mango, 150 g Maple Hill, 80 g cottage cheese, 5 g lime juice, 30 g Noble, no honey. Spin Lite Ice Cream. ≈ 460 cal · 49 g P; ⅓ ≈ 153 cal · 16 g P.

creami.name: Notes
creami.desc: Make Sunday, freeze level 24 h. Blend each base 30–45 s, fill to the max line. Re-spin with 15–30 g milk if crumbly. Totals for 6 pints: Maple Hill 970 g · cottage cheese 590 g · milk 180 g · Noble 102 g · 1 scoop each Equip chocolate PB and cookies & cream · mango 230 g · cocoa 8 g · cacao nibs 6 g · honey 44 g · vanilla 8 g · pistachio butter 25 g. Macros are estimates (Noble 24 g ≈ 90 cal / 20 g P, not yet checked against the tub).

prep.title: Delivery day
prep.step: FREEZE on arrival: salmon, sirloin, chicken thighs, ground beef, nuggets. FRIDGE: chuck roast + chicken breasts (cooked Sunday). Maple Hill from Publix straight to the fridge.

prep.title: Salmon to the fridge
prep.step: Move the 1.25 lb salmon from the freezer to the fridge on a plate so it's thawed for Monday.

prep.title: Roast in first
prep.step: Oven to 325°F. Bloom the gelatin in 60 g of the measured broth. Season the chuck (no sear) and into the pot over the onion and garlic with the citrus, vinegar, honey, tomato paste-miso, broth and bay leaves. Lid on; in the oven by 12:45. Done ~4:45.

prep.title: Bone broth rice (big batch)
prep.step: Rinse 1,100 g jasmine. Split across two 4–5 qt saucepans (or the stainless rice cooker + 1 pot): each 550 g rice + 950 g bone broth + ½ tsp salt. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min → ~2,750 g (weigh; need 2,750 g; top up with a small pot if short). Spread on 2 sheet pans to cool; fridge within 1 hr.

prep.title: Lunch chicken (air fryer, 4 batches)
prep.step: Pound and season 5.5 lb air-chilled breasts lemon-oregano. Air-fry ~1⅜ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min, flipping halfway, to 165°F: batches at ~12:55, 1:15, 1:35, 1:55. Rest each batch on a board.

prep.title: Creami bases (6 pints)
prep.step: Between air-fryer flips: blend and fill 2 honey vanilla, 1 chocolate PB, 1 cookies & cream, 1 pistachio, 1 mango. Lids on, freeze level. ~40 min.

prep.title: Aji verde + lime crema
prep.step: Blend the aji verde (180 g Maple Hill, 30 g cilantro, 15 g parmesan, 15 g lime, 1 garlic, 3 g salt); 6 cups × 40 g. Stir the lime crema (170 g Maple Hill + zest of 1 lime + 20 g lime juice + 1.5 g salt). Fridge both.

prep.title: Peas and carrots
prep.step: 3 bags frozen peas and carrots in 2 batches, covered with 45 g broth each, 6–7 min; season with salt, honey, lemon. Spread to cool 10 min.

prep.title: Portion + label (scale out)
prep.step: FRIDGE: Rory boxes Mon/Tue/Wed (200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas/carrots) · Wendy boxes Mon/Tue/Wed (150 + 120 + 100) · Chloe Mon (70 g chicken + 100 g rice) · Chloe Tue (100 g rice + 40 g peas/carrots) · Mon dinner rice 330 g · Tue rice 370 g. FREEZER: Rory Thu + Fri boxes, Wendy Thu box, Thu dinner rice 450 g. Keep 340 g rice out for tonight + 100 g for Chloe's Thu jar. Label dish / day / grams / 'cooked 11/15'.

prep.title: Fruit + clean up
prep.step: Wash and cut fruit for bowls (kiwi, strawberries, blueberries); leave mangoes, apples and mandarins whole. Clean up; everything put away by ~3:30. Break until 4:40.

prep.title: Zucchini prep
prep.step: Cut the 3 zucchini into half-moons onto a parchment-lined half-sheet pan.

prep.title: Roast out + shred; oven up
prep.step: Check it shreds easily (~200–205°F); if not, 20–30 min more. Oven up to 425°F. Shred into the juices, bay leaves out; reduce on the stove 5–8 min if thin.

prep.title: Pack beef + Chloe's Thu jar
prep.step: Tue container 360 g beef + ½ cup juices → fridge. Chloe's Thu jar 70 g beef + 1 Tbsp juices + 100 g rice → freezer.

prep.title: Zucchini in
prep.step: Roast at 425°F 16–18 min; toss with garlic, lime and cilantro. Meanwhile warm 340 g rice with 2 Tbsp broth and stir in cilantro + lime.

prep.title: Dinner
prep.step: Plate beef, cilantro-lime rice, crema, zucchini; chipotle for Rory. Creami third right after dinner.

prep.title: Thaw + to-do schedule
prep.step: Mon night: sirloin → fridge (Wed). Tue night: ground beef → fridge (Thu); make chimichurri. Wed night: thighs → fridge (Fri); blend the Wed-night aji verde; Rory Thu box, Wendy Thu box, Thu rice and Chloe's Thu jar → fridge; pack Chloe's crema cup. Thu night: Rory Fri box → fridge; marinate the thighs; pack Wendy's Fri lunch. Wed AM: nuggets straight from the freezer.

prepNote: Sun Nov 15: roast in by 12:45; rice, 5.5 lb lunch chicken, 6 Creami, aji verde + crema, peas and carrots, portioning 12:40–3:30 while it braises; zucchini + dinner ~5:15.

lunchIntro: Each morning: fill the 12 oz thermal jar with boiling water for 5–10 min, then dump it. Heat the hot food to 165°F (steaming), pack it into the warmed jar, and close it. Cold food goes in the steel bento with an ice pack, and everything goes in the insulated bag.
prepIntro: Times assume a 12:15 PM start and dinner around 5:15 PM. About 2¾ hours hands-on (the air fryer runs 4 chicken batches while you do rice, Creami and sauces), then a break while the roast finishes. Tuesday is the car-jar dinner (15 min), Saturday is the night out, and Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri dinners are cooked fresh (25–40 min).
prepSafety: Chicken 165°F (thighs best at 175°F); ground-beef meatballs 160°F; salmon 145°F; steak 130–135°F medium-rare (USDA 145°F); chuck shreds at ~200–205°F; reheated leftovers 165°F. Bell & Evans nuggets are sold uncooked: cook to 170°F.
Cool fast: spread rice on sheet pans; everything into the fridge within 1–2 hours (rice within 1 hour).
Fridge = eaten Mon–Wed. Freezer = Thu onward (Rory Thu/Fri boxes, Wendy Thu box, Thu dinner rice, Chloe's Thu jar). Aji verde for Thu–Fri is blended fresh Wed night.
Thermal jars: preheat with boiling water, pack food at 165°F, eat within 4 hours. Reheat each portion only once. Label every container with dish, day, grams and 'cooked 11/15'.
prepThaw: Sat Nov 14 (delivery): freeze the salmon, sirloin, thighs, ground beef and nuggets right away; chuck and breasts go in the fridge for Sunday.
